name: Message Actions
description: The action row under an AI reply: Copy morphs to a check, Regenerate inks in a new take, thumbs ask why, and 2 / 3 rolls between versions.

props.name: versions
props.default: two takes of a release note
props.description: Every version of the reply so far, oldest first: { id, paragraphs: string[], meta? }. Each Regenerate appends one.

props.name: author
props.description: The assistant's name, above the reply and in the reason popover.

props.name: onRegenerate
props.description: Produces a new version. The row shows Writing version N… until it resolves; reject to show an error line. Without it the Regenerate button is hidden.

props.name: onCopy
props.description: Called with the plain text after it is written to the clipboard.

props.name: onFeedback
props.description: Called when a rating is set, cleared, or sent with reasons: { versionId, value: "up" | "down" | null, reasons, note }. Ratings are kept per version.

props.name: onVersionChange
props.description: Called when the visible version changes (0-based).

props.name: feedback
props.description: Show thumbs up and down. Thumbs down opens an optional reason popover.

props.name: reasons
props.default: Not accurate, Missed the brief, Too long, Wrong tone
props.description: Choices offered in the thumbs-down popover.

props.name: alwaysVisible
props.description: Keep the actions on screen. Off, they fade in on hover or keyboard focus, and are always shown on touch screens. A chosen rating and the version counter stay visible either way.

props.name: size
props.description: Action row scale: 28px or 32px buttons (44px on coarse pointers).

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: a chosen rating, picked reasons and the Send feedback button.

props.name: theme
props.description: Ink and surfaces for dark or light pages.

props.name: branches
props.description: Demo only. How many versions exist before the first Regenerate (1–4).
